title: Daily Life Score Stability Trend
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| search stability_score=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(stability_score) as avg_stability_score min(stability_score) as min_stability_score by _time month
| sort - _time
description: Tracks daily life score stability over time and breaks it out by month.
value: Stability over time is often a better goal than constant improvement because it captures how reliably the system supports you.
implementation: Send daily life score stability events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of daily life score stability by month.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how daily life score stability changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
